rows.name: OpenTaxRate
rows.published: Free. $0 with only its own geocoders (Nominatim, Photon, Pelias), or the providers' prices for any commercial geocoders you add keys for
rows.method: No fee from us. What the commercial geocoders bill, per 1,000 lookups, measured on 309 random addresses with every provider on (Census, OpenStreetMap, Geocodio, HERE, Mapbox, Esri, Google):
rows.estimateNote: $0 within free tiers; at most about $1.14 once every free tier is used up
breakdown: With only its own geocoders, no provider is paid: $0 plus hosting.

Total about $1.14; without Google, about $1.04. Free tiers first: Geocodio 2,500 a day, HERE 30,000 a month, Mapbox 100,000 a month, Esri 20,000 a month, Google 10,000 a month. Hosting is not included.

rows.name: Stripe Tax
rows.method: $0.05 × 1,000, using the Calculations API alone. With the Transaction API, each $0.50 transaction includes 10 calculations.

rows.name: Zip-Tax
rows.method: The plan doesn't state its included calls; the low end assumes the pricing calculator's default of 15,000 a month, the high end is the overage rate. The free plan says 100 calls a month, but on our account it was 100 calls in total.

rows.name: Quaderno
rows.method: API calls are capped at 10× the plan's transactions: $83 ÷ 10,000. The smallest plan works out to $96.

rows.name: TaxCloud
rows.method: $79 ÷ 2,000 lookups. The price is from our 2026-10-21 reading; on 2026-10-22 the page showed order tiers without prices.

rows.name: TaxJar
rows.method: $99 ÷ 2,000 lookups, on Professional, the cheapest plan with the API.

rows.name: Avalara AvaTax
rows.method: The rates-by-address call is free but needs a paid AvaTax account. One state at $699 a year over 1,000 lookups a month; each state adds a fee.

rows.name: Lovat
rows.published: €20 per 5,000 extra transactions, plus a plan fee
rows.method: 10 lookups count as one transaction, so €20 covers 50,000 lookups past the plan's allowance. The plan fee isn't published. Lovat is now called Lappa.

rows.name: APIVerve
rows.published: $29.99/mo for 200,000 credits (2 per call); free plan 200 credits a month
rows.method: $29.99 ÷ 100,000 calls on Starter, the vendor's own figure. Larger plans come to $0.20 and $0.15. The API takes a 5-digit ZIP code.

rows.name: Anrok
rows.method: Calculations aren't metered, so the cost depends on volume: $100 at 1,000 lookups a month in one market, $10 at 10,000. From our 2026-10-21 reading; the page refused our request on 2026-10-22.

rows.name: Zip2Tax
rows.method: $1,500 ÷ 12,000 lookups, for the street-address database. The ZIP-level one is $389 a year.

notes.text: The plan also covers filing, registration or other compliance work, so this is the whole plan fee spread over lookups, not a per-call price like Stripe's.
A lookup counts as a fraction of an order or transaction (1/10).
Rates by ZIP code, not street address.
